digest.component_or_area: LLM configuration and model class system
propositions: REBAR_LLM_MODEL is a single scalar that cannot express per-tier model mappings and is superseded by per-class environment variables and configuration table entries
The deprecated variable must warn on every read via os.environ.get at exactly two sites: config.py:469 and model_classes.py, with provenance required to avoid false positives

REBAR_LLM_MODEL must map to all three classes as a fallback default only when explicit class configuration is absent, applying the documented precedence CLI > per-class env > config table > bare env > built-in default
The deprecation is registered in _deprecations.REGISTRY via _scheduled with permanent=False and remove_in=_MAJOR, not _permanent, because it is a SUPERSESSION by a different interface not a RENAME
User-facing strings in --help output, MCP tool descriptions, and module docstrings must no longer present REBAR_LLM_MODEL as the current model-selection interface
Example configurations for each provider model must be added to docs as complete pasteable [tool.rebar.llm.model_classes] tables, not fragments
